## Geographic spread of restaurants with critical violations

Across the SLCHD‑matched dataset, **123 restaurants** have at least one confirmed critical violation on record (out of the establishments with inspection history). The map (from `search_establishments`, sorted by critical violation count) plots the top 50 of these, spanning Salt Lake City, Midvale, Murray, South Salt Lake, West Valley City, Taylorsville, Sandy, Draper, South Jordan, and West Jordan — i.e., spread broadly across the whole Salt Lake Valley rather than clustered in one area.

Highlights from the ranked list (critical violation count / most recent inspection score):
- **Sagato Bakery & Cafe** (Midvale) – 47 critical violations, most recent score 1
- **Stella Grill** (Millcreek) – 38 critical violations, most recent score 10
- **Texas Roadhouse** (Taylorsville) – 38 critical violations, most recent score 14
- **Siegfried's Delicatessen** (Salt Lake City) – 34 critical violations, most recent score 6
- **Navajo Hogan** (South Salt Lake) – 33 critical violations, most recent score 4

A note on coverage: only establishments with a matched SLCHD inspection history are counted here — most Google-listed restaurants (98.4% overall) have no inspection record at all, so this map reflects the subset that could actually be evaluated, not the full restaurant landscape.

The bar chart breaks down the same 123 restaurants by city, showing Salt Lake City has by far the largest number of restaurants with at least one critical violation, followed by the suburban cities (Midvale, Murray, West Valley City, Sandy, Taylorsville, etc.) — largely proportional to how many restaurants/inspections exist in each area.

FROM (
  SELECT e.gmap_id

  JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
  WHERE v.is_critical = true
  GROUP BY e.gmap_id
)
'})

input.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_establishments_with_critical_violation
FROM (
  SELECT e.gmap_id
  FROM establishments e
  JOIN inspections i ON e.slchd_establishment_key = i.slchd_establishment_key
  JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
  JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id
  WHERE vc.critical = true
  GROUP BY e.gmap_id
)

input.query:
SELECT ek.city AS city, COUNT(*) AS n_establishments
FROM (
  SELECT e.gmap_id, e.slchd_establishment_key
  FROM establishments e
  JOIN inspections i ON e.slchd_establishment_key = i.slchd_establishment_key
  JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
  JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id
  WHERE vc.critical = true
  GROUP BY e.gmap_id, e.slchd_establishment_key
) sub
JOIN establishment_keys ek ON sub.slchd_establishment_key = ek.slchd_establishment_key
GROUP BY ek.city
ORDER BY n_establishments DESC
LIMIT 15
